m.chalisa.do1: Whoever prays and pays honour with firm resolve, love and faith, Hanumān brings all his undertakings to an auspicious fulfilment.
m.chalisa.cau1: Victory to Hanumān, benefactor of the saints; Lord, please hear our plea.
m.chalisa.cau2: Make no delay in your devotee's work; come running in haste and give great joy.
m.chalisa.cau3: As you leapt across the ocean to the land beyond, and entered Surasā's mouth when she spread it wide;
m.chalisa.cau4: as, when you went on, Laṅkinī stopped you, and you kicked her and she went to the world of the gods;
m.chalisa.cau5: as you went and gave joy to Vibhīṣaṇa, and, beholding Sītā, attained the highest bliss;
m.chalisa.cau6: as you laid the garden waste and sank it in the ocean, and in great haste broke the dagger of Yama;
m.chalisa.cau7: as you struck down and slew Akṣaya Kumāra, and with your wrapped tail burnt Laṅkā;
m.chalisa.cau8: Laṅkā burnt like lac, and cries of victory, victory rose in the city of the gods.
m.chalisa.cau9: Now, Master, why the delay? Be gracious, you who dwell in the heart and know all.
m.chalisa.cau10: Victory, victory to you who gave Lakṣmaṇa back his life; make haste, strike down the sorrow and take it away.
m.chalisa.cau11: Victory to you, bearer of the mountain; victory, victory, ocean of joy, mighty among the host of the gods, foremost of warriors.
m.chalisa.cau12: Śrī hanu hanu hanu (strike, strike, strike), resolute Hanumān; kill the enemies and pin them fast with the thunderbolt.
m.chalisa.cau13: Take your mace and thunderbolt and strike the enemies; great king, Lord, rescue your servant.
m.chalisa.cau14: Come running, Lord, with the roar of Om; strike with thunderbolt and mace, and make no delay.
m.chalisa.cau15: Om hrīṃ hrīṃ hrīṃ, Hanumān, lord of the monkeys; Om huṃ huṃ huṃ, strike the enemy's heart and head.
m.chalisa.cau16: Bound by the oath of Hari, prove true; messenger of Rāma, run, seize and strike.
m.chalisa.cau17: Victory, victory, victory to you, unfathomable Hanumān; for what offence does your devotee suffer sorrow?
m.chalisa.cau18: Worship, japa, austerity, observance and right conduct: I know none of these; I am your servant.
m.chalisa.cau19: In forest, grove, road, mountain or house, by your strength we have no fear.
m.chalisa.cau20: I fall at your feet and entreat you with folded hands; at this hour whom else shall I call upon?
m.chalisa.cau21: Victory to you, mighty son of Añjanī, son of Śiva, heroic Hanumān.
m.chalisa.cau22: Your face is terrible, and you destroy the race of Death; you are Śrī Rāma's helper and ever the protector.
m.chalisa.cau23: Ghosts, spirits, piśācas, demons, fire-vetālas, death, pestilence and plague:
m.chalisa.cau24: kill these; you are bound by Śrī Rāma's oath. Lord, keep the honour of the name.
m.chalisa.cau25: You are called the servant of Janaka's daughter and of Hari; by her oath, make no delay.
m.chalisa.cau26: Cries of victory, victory, victory sound in the sky; at your remembrance unbearable sorrow is destroyed.
m.chalisa.cau27: I take refuge at your feet and entreat you with folded hands; at this hour whom else shall I call upon?
m.chalisa.cau28: Rise, rise and go; I adjure you by Śrī Rāma. I fall at your feet and entreat you with folded hands.
m.chalisa.cau29: Om caṃ caṃ caṃ caṃ, you who move so swiftly; Om hanu hanu hanu hanu, Hanumān.
m.chalisa.cau30: Om haṃ haṃ, nimble Hanumān gives a shout; Om saṃ saṃ, the hosts of the wicked have fled in terror.
m.chalisa.cau31: Rescue your devotee at once; at your remembrance joy comes to us.
m.chalisa.cau32: Whom this Bajaraṅga Bāṇa strikes, tell me, who then can save him?
m.chalisa.cau33: Whoever recites the Bajaraṅga Bāṇa, Hanumān protects his life.
m.chalisa.cau34: Whoever chants this Bajaraṅga Bāṇa, all ghosts and spirits tremble before him.
m.chalisa.cau35: Those who offer incense and chant it always, no affliction remains in their body.
m.chalisa.do2: Whoever worships Hanumān with love and faith and ever holds him in meditation in his heart, Hanumān brings all his undertakings to an auspicious fulfilment.
